workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for both same-date Selected objects. Q-20260918-01 read the complete Social Laws primary study across formal model, alpha-robustness, social-law comparison, worst-case-MDP verification, approximate value bounds, grid experiments and limits. The paper shows that individually optimal policies can interact badly, and that a shared action restriction can be verified inside a declared stochastic-game model by solving each single-agent projection and one worst-case MDP per agent. The important boundary is that robustness alpha must be considered together with retained guaranteed utility: a more restrictive law can improve robustness while lowering useful performance, and the guarantee depends on the modeled state/action/reward/transition space, all agents remaining inside the assumed policy class, and Assumption 1 requiring optimal actions at every state. The paper's formal definition assumes positive rewards while its experiments use all-negative costs, which the text says admit an analogous formulation but does not re-derive in equal detail. The bounded Runtime finding is that Coordination-rule Identity, Model Identity, Robustness Evidence, Utility Evidence, Execution Admission, Business Authorization and Effect Verification must remain separate facts. Q-20260918-02 read the complete Ask the Tool, Don't Guess primary study. It distinguishes strong remaining-work signals from weak near-completion signals, exports call-id/work-done/total/phase/timestamp telemetry over a side channel that leaves the agent-visible result path unchanged, and reports that live progress is materially more accurate than duration-history predictors at KV-cache decision points and under environment changes. In a 4xH100 serving replay, the reported p90 post-tool-call TTFT reduction versus LRU is 20.7% for HBM-only and 20.8% for HBM+DRAM. The paper explicitly treats tenant-originated progress as untrusted input, bounds its scheduling influence through session credit, and identifies opaque tools, parser gaps and behavior-changing instrumentation as limitations. The bounded Runtime finding is that Execution Identity, Progress Observation, Telemetry Confidence, Scheduling Authority, Business Completion and Effect Authorization/Verification must remain separate; progress may justify waiting or resource reallocation but cannot by itself prove completion or authorize retry. Reading performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication. workResult_zh: Skill 03 已对两个同日 Selected Object 完成来源边界内的 Deep Reading。Q-20260918-01 完整深读 Social Laws 一手研究的形式模型、alpha-robustness、Social-law 比较、Worst-case MDP Verification、近似 Value Bound、Grid 实验与边界。论文说明，单个 Agent 各自执行最优 Policy 并不能证明联合行为安全；在明确声明的 Stochastic-game Model 内，可以先求解每个 Single-agent Projection，再为每个 Agent 构造并求解一个 Worst-case MDP，从而验证共享 Action Restriction 的鲁棒性。关键边界是 alpha 不能单独作为采用依据，还必须同时看 Restriction 后保留下来的 Guaranteed Utility：规则更严格可能提高 Robustness，却降低实际效用；而 Guarantee 依赖完整声明的 State/Action/Reward/Transition Model、所有 Agent 均停留在假定 Policy Class 内，以及 Assumption 1 所要求的每个 State 都选择最优 Action。论文形式定义假定 Positive Reward，而实验使用全负 Cost；正文说明全负 Cost 可定义类似形式，但没有用同等细节重新推导。因此边界 Runtime 结论是 Coordination-rule Identity、Model Identity、Robustness Evidence、Utility Evidence、Execution Admission、Business Authorization 与 Effect Verification 必须保持为不同事实。Q-20260918-02 完整深读 Ask the Tool, Don't Guess 一手研究。研究区分可表示 Remaining Work 的 Strong Signal 与只能表示 Near-completion 的 Weak Signal，通过不改变 Agent-visible Result Path 的 Side Channel 输出 Call-id、Work-done、Total、Phase、Timestamp 进度事件，并显示 Live Progress 在 KV-cache 决策点及环境变化下明显优于基于历史 Duration 的 Predictor。4xH100 Serving Replay 中，相对 LRU 报告的 Tool Call 后 p90 TTFT 降幅为 HBM-only 20.7%、HBM+DRAM 20.8%。论文明确把 Tenant-originated Progress 视为 Untrusted Input，用 Session Credit 限制它对调度的影响，并把 Tool 不暴露信息、Parser 缺口和 Instrumentation 改变 Tool Behavior 列为边界。边界 Runtime 结论是 Execution Identity、Progress Observation、Telemetry Confidence、Scheduling Authority、Business Completion 与 Effect Authorization/Verification 必须分离；Progress 可以支持继续等待或资源重分配，但不能单独证明完成，更不能单独授权 Retry。Reading 未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。精确两份 Note Head 20d93522eeff716c8fe14be728e14572c41a1964 已在本 Result 持久化前通过 Validate Research Center 3.0 Run 35302389225 的 Validate Runtime Center 步骤。
